sponsor an event: A local bank agreed to sponsor an event that raises money for children's hospitals every year.
一家當地銀行同意贊助一場每年為兒童醫院募款的活動。
sponsor a child: For a small amount each month, you can sponsor a child in a poor country and pay for her school.
每個月只要一小筆錢，你就可以認養貧窮國家的一個小孩，替她支付學費。
sponsor a bill: The lawmaker decided to sponsor a bill that would ban the sale of single-use plastic bags.
這位立法委員決定提案一項禁止販售一次性塑膠袋的法案。
sponsor research: Several large companies sponsor research at the university to help scientists find cleaner kinds of energy.
幾家大公司資助大學的研究，幫助科學家找到更乾淨的能源。
spot a mistake: Can you read my essay once more? I want you to spot a mistake if there is one before I hand it in.
你可以再讀一次我的作文嗎？在我交出去之前，如果有錯誤，希望你能發現。
spot talent: The coach has a great ability to spot talent, even in young players who have never played seriously.
這位教練很有發掘人才的能力，即使是在從未認真比賽過的年輕球員身上也一樣。
spot the difference: The two pictures look the same at first, but if you look carefully, you can spot the difference.
這兩張圖乍看之下一樣，但如果你仔細看，就能找出不同。
on the spot: The manager liked her answers so much that he offered her the job on the spot.
經理非常喜歡她的回答，當場就給了她這份工作。
spot a trend: Smart shop owners can spot a trend early and start selling popular items before other stores do.
聰明的店主能及早看出趨勢，在其他店家之前就開始販售熱門商品。
hit the spot: After a long, cold walk in the rain, a bowl of hot beef noodles really hit the spot.
在雨中又冷又長的一段路之後，一碗熱騰騰的牛肉麵真是正合需要。
a blind spot: Drivers should check carefully before changing lanes, because a motorcycle may be in a blind spot.
駕駛人在變換車道前應仔細查看，因為可能有機車在盲點裡。
spray paint: Someone used spray paint to draw pictures on the school wall, and the principal was very angry.
有人用噴漆在學校的牆上畫圖，校長非常生氣。
spray crops: Farmers sometimes use small drones to spray crops with water and medicine against insects.
農夫有時會用小型無人機噴灑作物，噴水和防蟲藥劑。
spray water: On hot afternoons, my grandfather likes to spray water on the plants with a long garden hose.
在炎熱的午後，我爺爺喜歡用長長的水管往植物上灑水。
spray bullets: In the action movie, the bad guys spray bullets everywhere, but the hero is never hit.
在那部動作片裡，壞人到處掃射，但英雄從來沒被打中。
spread the word: Please help us spread the word about the charity concert by sharing the poster with your friends.
請把海報分享給你的朋友，幫我們傳播慈善音樂會的消息。
spread the cost: Instead of paying all at once, you can spread the cost of the new laptop over twelve months.
你不必一次付清，可以把新筆電的費用分攤成十二個月來付。
the disease spreads: Doctors advise everyone to wash their hands often, because the disease spreads easily in crowded places.
醫生建議大家常洗手，因為這種疾病在擁擠的地方很容易蔓延。
spread one's wings: After high school, Lisa wanted to spread her wings and study in a big city far from home.
高中畢業後，麗莎想要展翅高飛，到離家很遠的大城市讀書。
spread oneself too thin: If you join five clubs and take three part-time jobs, you will spread yourself too thin.
如果你參加五個社團又做三份兼職，你會把自己攤得太開，分身乏術。
spread like wildfire: The news about the singer's secret wedding spread like wildfire on social media within an hour.
那位歌手秘密結婚的消息在一小時內就在社群媒體上迅速蔓延開來。
spring to mind: When I think of a perfect summer day, a picture of the beach and cold ice cream springs to mind.
當我想到完美的夏日時，海灘和冰涼冰淇淋的畫面就浮現腦海。
spring a surprise: Our teacher likes to spring a surprise on us by giving a quiz on the first day after vacation.
我們的老師喜歡出其不意，在放假後的第一天就給我們小考。
spring into action: As soon as the fire alarm rings, the firefighters spring into action and run to their trucks.
火警鈴一響，消防員就立刻行動，跑向他們的消防車。
spring from: Many of his fears spring from a bad experience he had in the ocean when he was a child.
他的許多恐懼源自他小時候在海裡的一次可怕經驗。
spring a leak: The old boat began to spring a leak in the middle of the lake, so we rowed back quickly.
那艘舊船在湖中央開始漏水，所以我們趕快划回岸邊。
spring to life: Every night when the market opens, the quiet little street seems to spring to life with lights and music.
每晚夜市開張時，安靜的小街似乎就隨著燈光和音樂活了過來。
spring up: In the past few years, many new coffee shops seem to spring up in our neighborhood every month.
過去幾年，我們社區似乎每個月都湧現許多新的咖啡店。
